NMS 06:00 | CRITICAL | transmission HOR49->VEY26 | fibre/MW path down, no sync

finding.finding: Only the authoritative snapshots establish current operational facts. The two sites have lost grid power, and link L20 is down; equipment condition is not stated.

Resolved faults: S01 has a verified grid-power fault, and L20 has a verified backhaul fault. S02 and S20 grid-power status remain unknown; do not assume faults or dismiss the unknowns. No road closures, hazards, or other evidence makes catalogue actions unsafe or impossible. Available crews and catalogue skills support the known repairs; no defer request is justified. G1 is available at the depot and G2 is unavailable at S03, but generator deployment is not needed for the resolved faults on the supplied evidence.

finding.finding: V20 at Veyangoda (S20) is the only approved critical service, with weight 5; the other listed services have standard weight 1. The authoritative snapshots show mains/rectifier input loss at Beruwala (V01) and Veyangoda (V20), and a critical transmission-path outage from Horana to Veyangoda. Thus V20’s outage is most significant by approved weight, while the Beruwala outage affects a standard-weight service. No supplied credible evidence supports changing any service’s approved priority. The customer complaint about Minuwangoda is not a specific asset claim; the Veyangoda repair rumour is ununf
